paras: ASH CLOUD GROUNDS PLANES ACROSS EUROPE
Volcano in Iceland sends ash high into the sky

Thousands of flights across Europe were cancelled in April 2010 after a volcano erupted under a glacier in southern Iceland. The volcano, Eyjafjallajokull, sent a huge cloud of fine ash high into the sky.
"The sky turned grey in the middle of the day," said a farmer who lives nearby.
